description: This file contains implementations of parsing functions for various command-line options within a Git-related tool, including handling of abbreviations, expiry dates, color flags, verbosity levels, commits, object names, and other options. It also provides utility functions for managing options lists and recreating command-line options.

methods.name: int parse_opt_abbrev_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses abbreviation options, setting a numerical value with limits.

methods.name: int parse_opt_expiry_date_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses expiry date options, handling 'never' as a special case.

methods.name: int parse_opt_color_flag_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses color flag options, converting string to enumerated color bool.

methods.name: int parse_opt_verbosity_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Adjusts verbosity level based on options.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commits(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Processes commit object names and inserts them into a commit list.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commit(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Processes a single commit object name.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_name(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles object name options, updating an oid array.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_id(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles object ID options, setting to a specific oid.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tertiary(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets a tertiary option (likely a flag or mode).

methods.name: struct:option * parse_options_concat(const struct option * a,const struct option * b)
int parse_opt_string_list(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
int parse_opt_strvec(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
int parse_opt_noop_cb(const struct option * opt UNUSED,const char * arg UNUSED,int unset UNUSED)
methods.description: A no-operation callback for options that require no special handling.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Recreates command-line options into a string and stores in a char*.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru_argv(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Recreates command-line options and appends to a strvec.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tracking_mode(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Handles tracking mode options, setting branch tracking enums.

methods.name: int recreate_opt(struct strbuf * sb,const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
